<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Load a package onto its load (create a loading)"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/packages/{packageId}/loadings"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Moves a `STAGED` or `EXPECTED` package to `LOADED` through the named
door and publishes `PackageLoaded`. The package loads only onto its
own load and through that load's door: another load id or another
door is `409 wrong-load` (`ErrWrongLoad`); a package already on
another load is `409 package-on-another-load`
(`ErrPackageOnAnotherLoad`).
